title: The thank-you card
explanation: Three lines held private details: a name with a class and school, a home address, and a phone number. The card did not need any of them, so a label or nothing at all would have worked.
setup: Mei is about to send this to an assistant to get help with a thank-you card. Tap every line with a private detail she should take out first.

sentences.text: Write a thank-you card to my grandmother for the birthday scarf.
My full name is Mei Lin Zhao, and I am in Class 5B at Riverside Primary.
sentences.note: A full name with a class and a school can point to one real child. Use [MY NAME] and [MY CLASS] instead.

sentences.text: Tell her the scarf is my favourite colour, green.
Her address is 8 Willow Court, so add it to the envelope.
sentences.note: A home address should not go into an order. Add it to the envelope yourself, on paper.

sentences.text: Keep it to four short sentences.
My mum's phone number is 555-0166, in case she wants to call.
sentences.note: A phone number belongs to a real person. Leave it out, and tell her yourself.
